In this video I break down why most people start businesses the wrong way and show how to flip the process by asking buyers what they actually want before building anything. I run a live poll with real business owners to figure out which website features they would actually pay for, then use that data to build a working software tool in real time using AI, without any coding. I walk through validating the idea, analyzing the responses with ChatGPT, and turning it into a simple appointment-booking widget that could be sold to real businesses. The big takeaway is how fast you can go from idea to working product when you focus on pain, not guesses, and let AI handle the build so you can move fast and launch.


Enjoy!
